notes: Most of the sheet is Taft Park and lots; only Vine, Hollister and Thill with the stubs south of Thill. At the top Vine forks: Vine continues straight NNE (60 ft) and a second street (about 40 ft, no name or width printed) leaves Vine going NW along the west side of the V-shaped block; recorded as '?' (on the key map it runs from Vine up toward W. McMillan, unnamed there). Hollister and the '?' branch both end at Vine (T). West of Vine at Thill is volume 3 (Baum continues the line west, not drawn); Vine/Thill recorded as T. Rice printed 'RICE (NOT OPEN)' with a 4 in. water pipe; drawn with solid lines, recorded as a T at Thill. Loth and Rice and the unnamed 20 ft alley run south off the sheet into 169 (alley drawn to the bottom of the drawn area). Thill has no north edge east of Loth (Taft Park). The vertical line near x 3645 on the east side is a property line, not a street.
